name: Crystal Stairway to Aurora
description: A colossal crystal staircase spiraling upward into an ethereal aurora sky, with floating lanterns that pulse in rhythm with the shimmering lights above.
prompt: Staircase made of massive transparent crystals winding into a night sky filled with dancing green and pink auroras, floating lanterns emitting soft golden light, mist below, wide angle view, ultra‑realistic, cinematic lighting, no visible text, sense of wonder and scale.
caption: Climb the luminous crystal steps toward the dancing northern lights—your ascent becomes a journey through pure wonder.
